message.content: LiHua is the one who considers purchasing Sekiro: Shadows Die Twice and seeks the opinion of ThaneChambers. According to the dialogue, LiHua expressed interest in the game and asked for ThaneChambers' thoughts on whether it is worth getting. ThaneChambers responded positively, recommending the game due to its unique combat system and challenging battles, and advised LiHua to be prepared for tough encounters.
